carnival_half.label: Great Roller Coaster with Steep Humps
carnival_half.detail: Steep vermilion iron humps, bedrock trestles, and a safety-bar car carrying a suspended shout at the crest.

carnival_half.label: Carousel with Spoke of Chains
carnival_half.detail: Gilt radial hub spinning flying seats on tensioned iron chain spokes above bolted foundation piers.

carnival_half.label: Ferris Wheel of Spinning Cages
carnival_half.detail: High spoked wheel carrying revolving wire-and-brass passenger cages anchored permanently to the square.

carnival_half.label: Death-Ride with Crouching Motorcyclists
carnival_half.detail: Vertical timber-and-iron velodrome drum where crouching motorcyclists circle head-down by centrifugal force.

carnival_half.label: Big Top Dome with Clustered Trapezes
carnival_half.detail: Striped circus cupola whose cutaway oculus reveals a secret cluster of trapezes hanging at its center.

carnival_half.label: Shooting-Galleries Arcade
carnival_half.detail: Permanent tin-target fairground booths flanking the carousel as it counts the months in the empty plaza.

inner_arch.mechanism: Sophronia consists of two half-cities: a carnival fairground and a metropolis of stone, marble, and cement. Against every expectation, the carnival half is bedrock-permanent and refuses every rigging wrench, whereas the heavy civic/industrial half is nomadic—each year workmen unbolt its marble pediments, lower its stone walls and cement pylons, load the Ministry, monument, docks, petroleum refinery, hospital, bank, factories, palaces, slaughterhouse, and school onto flatbed trailers, and haul them away, leaving the lone roller coaster and carousel to count the months and days until the caravan returns.
